subject: FB-3b/astropy: onboard + inject + export KB (ON-self-learning)
description: ONE repo only: astropy/astropy @ b0db0daa. Clone from GitHub at that commit into /tmp scratch. `node scripts/onboard.js --repo <abs>` (mine→learn). Then `node scripts/onboard-learn.js --repo <abs> --inject --confirm` (inject into astropy's workspace; verify via search_knowledge). Then `node scripts/export-kb.js --repo <abs> --k 30 --min-score 0.1 > bench/featurebench-kb/astropy.selflearn.AGENTS.md`. Commit that one file. If KB empty/degenerate, record it. Use onboard.js NOT onboard-loop.js. Context: note-mqfh9nmj87j, pilot-manifest.json.
